name: CreatorMotion · Title Scene Takeover
description: An oversized condensed headline punches in behind a presenter. A clean edit removes the presenter while the same lettering holds its scale and position.

name: Dot Avatar Maker
description: Get the complete source of a live 3D avatar maker: a single HTML file with 25 cute dot, animal and fantasy forms, 12 finishes from soft plush to glazed ceramic, 32 boy and girl styles and 18 languages. Run it to design characters in your browser and download transparent PNGs or 3D pages you can spin, with no image generation and no credits. Then have your AI agent rebrand it, add your own forms and colors, or build it into your website or app as a character creator for your users.

name: CreatorMotion · Synchronized Action Checklist
description: Create a timed checklist animation for a short screen demonstration. The checklist completes at supplied moments. Use your own screen recording and matching action timestamps for a real demonstration; the included default is an illustrative static screen.

name: Velocity-Matched UI Sting
description: Build a short product sting where every cut is velocity-matched, so seven scenes read as one continuous camera move instead of a stack of screens. Delivered as a rendered MP4 plus a single-file project carrying a seam ledger, so the piece can be re-branded later without the motion coming apart.

name: GrokBot Avatar
description: Create rounded Original mascots or cute soft-vinyl Anime avatars with simple solid eyes and vivid colors. Follow explicit character requests first, use reliable user memories to personalize missing details for a personal avatar, and turn an approved shape into a matching toy-like character when requested.

name: Device-Canvas Product Launch
description: Build a launch film that puts your product's real screen on a device in a dark studio, scrolls it, zooms into the interface for one action, and resolves to the lockup through a colour-split reveal. Delivered as a rendered MP4 plus the editable project, with no 3D model and no generation model involved.

name: Agent-Chorus Capability Reel
description: Build a launch film that proves a capability works everywhere by showing four different surfaces typing the identical prompt, then drops into a beat-cut reel of what came out and closes on the install command. Delivered as a rendered MP4 plus the editable project.

name: Playful Primary Classroom Deck
description: Create an editable presentation with friendly bold headings with handwritten accents, ink-outline original children, pastel cards, and colorful doodle corners. Turn children’s creativity classes, hands-on activities, and family workshops into a clear sequence you can revise in your browser and export to PowerPoint.

name: Hand-Drawn Visual Notes
description: Turn source material into one focused 4:3 visual note, using hand-drawn illustrations, a strong English title, and a small set of accurate labels. It helps educators, creators, and teams make a process or idea easier to understand at a glance without reducing it to a dense slide.

name: Chat-to-Result Launch Film
description: Build a narrated launch film that plays out entirely inside a dark app interface — a prompt is typed, an answer streams back, a follow-up triggers your product, and the finished result lands with a count-up headline number. You get the seven-scene storyboard, the interface system, and a rendered MP4.

name: Liquid-Rupture Logo Reveal
description: Build a short logo-reveal sting where the mark rides inside a bead of liquid, refracted past the point of legibility, until the bead ruptures and leaves the lockup crisp on the frame. Delivered as a rendered MP4 plus the editable project, with no 3D asset and no generation model involved.

name: Sage Sneaker Store
description: Build a premium footwear or apparel store with a campaign feel: a sage hero with oversized white uppercase type, an editorial model photograph and a small white service card, then clean product grids on a matched studio backdrop. The example label, Stride Common, has 27 working pages with eight sneakers, four collections, product pages, bag, checkout, a size guide and help pages. By default you get one self-contained file that opens in any browser and works offline.

name: Field Notes Deck
description: Create refined outdoor-learning presentation pages with sky-blue sports photography, sage-green cards, frosted overlays, compact capsules, asymmetrical image tiles and independent original images. Use this visual language to present outdoor-learning programs with a clear, consistent rhythm. The slide count follows your brief, with original artwork planned around the content and layouts. Every deck can be edited in the browser and exported as an editable PowerPoint file.

name: Cadence Marketing Landing
description: Create a dark, motion-rich SaaS marketing site that tells one continuous product story: a charcoal ground, one cyan accent, grey-to-white gradient headlines and a believable product screen that tilts upright as you scroll. Animated feature cards, a scroll-driven workflow, a customer spotlight with portraits, integrations and security, tiered pricing and an FAQ lead to a laptop mockup whose lid opens on scroll, with changelog, customer story, sign-in and legal pages included. You get one self-contained file that opens in any browser and works offline.

name: Code-Change Explainer Film
description: Build a 30-second film that explains a code change to people who will never read the diff. It opens by scrolling the real change too fast to follow, cuts to the summary, then fires four capability tiles and closes on the install command — delivered as a rendered MP4 plus the editable project.

name: Slate Admin Console
description: Build a product-grade SaaS admin console in a calm, near-monochrome style where colour is kept for data and status. A slim two-group sidebar with no dead links sits beside a header with a command palette, light and dark modes and two theme presets. Seven working views cover overview, analytics, finance, customers, a drag-and-drop roadmap board, a month calendar and settings. The example product is Corvane, and the default output is one self-contained file that opens offline.

name: Yellow Sketchnote Deck
description: Create bold editorial presentation pages with oversized black and yellow typography, crisp white space, asymmetric copy islands, fine ink figures and independent original illustrations. Use this visual language to present small-team experiments with a clear, consistent rhythm. The slide count follows your brief, with original artwork planned around the content and layouts. Every deck can be edited in the browser and exported as an editable PowerPoint file.

name: Scattered-Cards Magazine
description: Build an independent magazine website on a white editorial ground: a hero fan of five rotated paper story cards, a heavy serif headline, a ruled and numbered topic index, generous photographic story grids and long-form article pages with drop caps, pull quotes and a facts aside. Topic archives, a shop for issues and prints with a bag and checkout, subscriptions with gift options, about, contact, FAQ, delivery and legal pages all connect. It arrives as one self-contained file that opens in any browser and works offline.

name: Chalkboard Infographic
description: Turn a lesson, process, or data story into a readable chalkboard-style infographic with clear hierarchy, concise copy, and original illustrations. It helps educators, creators, and teams make one takeaway easier to grasp and share without turning the image into a dense slide.

name: Scrapbook Resume Site
description: A multi-page online resume in a scrapbook style: a lanyard ID badge, a taped contact card, a torn notepaper intro, a cobalt marquee ribbon and a clipboard of sticky-note roles on cream paper. It includes Home, Experience with three role stories, Education, Skills and Tools, Projects with four case pages, Kind words, Contact and a printable one-page CV. By default it is one self-contained file that opens offline. Ideal for designers and job seekers who want a CV that feels handmade rather than templated.

name: Minimal Motion Hero
description: Minimal Motion Hero is a ready-to-paste hero section, delivered as editable source with its usage example. It ships with entrance motion that settles rather than bounces and state the visitor can change and see respond. Colour, type and radius live as tokens you edit once for the whole block.

name: Project Knowledge Graph
description: Create an offline project knowledge graph from Markdown, structured records, or a directory inventory. The result helps people browse entities, trace relationships, filter by type, and inspect the recorded source path behind each claim.

name: Notion Style OG Image
description: Create Notion-style OG images. Use them for social media posts.

name: Sky Glass Deck
description: Create a presentation with luminous sky photography, translucent glass cards, and elegant mixed typography. Use original, non-repeating imagery to make a complex subject feel approachable and clear. The slide count follows your request, with artwork planned around the content of each page. Every deck can be edited in the browser and exported as an editable PowerPoint file.

name: Monochrome Studio Portrait
description: Transform an authorized portrait into a refined black-and-white studio half portrait with soft directional light, natural texture, subtle grain, and deliberate negative space. It gives editors and personal brands a calm, distinctive image for profiles and social use while preserving the subject's identity and glasses on a best-effort basis.

name: Inclusive Cutpaper Deck
description: Create editorial workshop slides with heavy black grotesk headings, cream paper, vibrant portrait collages, highlighted monospace copy and editable cut-paper accents. Use this visual language to present collaboration workshops with a clear, consistent rhythm. Set the slide count to match the user's request. Every deck can be edited in the browser and exported as an editable PowerPoint file.

name: Claude Style Illustration
description: Create an Anthropic Style editorial illustration that turns one idea into an immediately readable visual metaphor. This independent workflow helps writers and product teams add a warm, human focal image and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic.

name: Brand Story Deck

Every deck can be edited in the browser and exported as an editable PowerPoint file.

name: Activity Calendar Chart

name: Interactive System Map
description: Build an offline interactive system map from a written description, code evidence, or a typed node-and-edge specification. The result makes architecture, data flow, sequence, and lifecycle relationships explorable without relying on a diagram service.

name: Editable Visual Deck
description: Create a polished presentation from editable text, shapes, diagrams, and chart elements. It prioritizes a dependable browser deck and records which objects stay native in the exported PowerPoint file. Every deck can be edited in the browser and exported as an editable PowerPoint file.

name: Article Brief Deck
description: Turns a verified article into a horizontally paged briefing deck with an argument spine, evidence slides, and discussion prompts. It delivers a complete horizontally paged example deck with speaker notes and three finished 16:9 previews. Every deck can be edited in the browser and exported as an editable PowerPoint file.

name: Beacon SaaS Landing
description: A calm SaaS marketing site on warm neutrals, lit by a single soft blue light beam, with gradient headlines, a quiet centered hero and your product shown as a live, working console instead of a screenshot. Below it come features, a tabbed product tour, setup steps, customer stories, monthly or yearly pricing with a comparison table, security and FAQ, plus sign-up, sign-in, sales, changelog, status, legal and 404 pages. Light and dark themes are both complete, and every link and form works.

name: Image Narrative Deck
description: Create an image-led presentation with cinematic pacing, editable live captions, and a coherent visual world. It is suited to documentary pitches, launch stories, cultural explainers, and narrative reports that benefit from full-frame scenes and restrained copy. Every deck can be edited in the browser and exported as an editable PowerPoint file.

name: Ochre Editorial Deck
description: Create an editorial presentation with cream paper, oversized compressed headlines, warm portrait collages, mustard and vermilion color fields, and original craft photography. Every image is independently composed and used once. The slide count follows your request, with artwork planned around the content of each page. Every deck can be edited in the browser and exported as an editable PowerPoint file.

Use this visual language to present visual identity guidelines with a clear, consistent rhythm. The slide count follows your request, with artwork planned around the content of each page. Every deck can be edited in the browser and exported as an editable PowerPoint file.

description: Masonry Testimonial Wall is a ready-to-paste testimonial section, delivered as editable source with its usage example. It ships with a canvas-rendered backdrop that runs without a WebGL library and entrance motion that settles rather than bounces. Colour, type and radius live as tokens you edit once for the whole block.

name: Consulting Storyline Deck
description: Creates a consulting storyline deck with action titles, restrained red accents, structured evidence blocks, and a recommendation-to-implementation sequence. It turns approved analysis into a client-ready argument with explicit assumptions and decision gates. Every deck can be edited in the browser and exported as an editable PowerPoint file.

name: Linktree Style OG Image
description: Create Linktree-style OG images. Use them for social media posts.

description: Create vivid gathering presentation pages using bright pink yellow green blue and cyan fields, heavy slanted titles, fine grids, cream cards, circular candid photos, festive vector accents and independent photographs. Use this whenever a user needs a workshop, onboarding, enablement, or instructional presentation that people must act on rather than merely read. Every deck can be edited in the browser and exported as an editable PowerPoint file.

name: Basalt Dev Portfolio
description: A complete personal developer site on a near-black ground with one cyan accent and clean Geist type. Beyond a home page with a small, self-aware headline, it includes case studies with drawn product windows, full articles, talks with notes, a Uses page, an About page with career milestones, a résumé and a contact form. It suits developers who want their work, writing and history to read as one coherent body of work rather than a list of links.

name: Research Talk Deck
description: Create a projection-ready Beamer/metropolis-inspired 16:9 HTML research talk with equations, method cadence, results, limits, slide numbers, and speaker notes. Use for colloquia, defenses, group meetings, and technical conference talks. Every deck can be edited in the browser and exported as an editable PowerPoint file.
